THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 33

I, V.O.L.S. Rathnasekara, Divisional Secretary of the Division of Mawanella in Kegalle District hereby give Notice under Section 33 of the Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460) that the Compensation money has been deposited to the following Case Numbers in the District Court of Mawanella to be received by the owners regarding the Acquisition of the Lands mentioned in the Schedule below.
